subject: Urgent: compact demo window needed due to overlapping regional OOO
messages:
From: Satoshi Yamamoto <satoshi.y@kibohealth.co.jp>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@brighthealth.co.uk>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:12:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — team availability constraints

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the overview earlier this week. Quick heads up — our delivery and product teams in Japan and India are entering overlapping leave windows: Golden Week prep for some vendors (internal planning time), and a regional Diwali blackout for a number of our India-based stakeholders the week after next. Separately, the UK side has an extended Easter substitute bank closure (they call it the 3rd-week coverage) at the same time as we try to pull people into a demo.

We really want to see the end-to-end latency and routing controls, but we have a hard constraint: we need the demo to happen in a compressed window (ideally 30–45 minutes) that touches each regional lead within a single cross-over slot rather than multiple separate time blocks.

Can you propose compact slots that work for APAC, EMEA and the US where at least one regional lead from each timezone can join in the same 45-minute block? If not possible, a 30-minute core demo followed by asynchronous follow-up recordings would also work.

Thanks — Satoshi
Product Operations, KiboHealth
[Attachment: org_calendar_export.ics (text/calendar)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Satoshi Yamamoto <satoshi.y@kibohealth.co.jp>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@brighthealth.co.uk>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 01:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — team availability constraints

Satoshi, Priya —

Appreciate the heads up. We can absolutely compress the runbook. To be explicit about trade-offs: a shorter, timeboxed session means we focus on the core flows (latency breakdown, smart routing/fallbacks, and caching behavior). Deeper topics (quantization, custom routing rules by policy) can be follow-ups or recorded short deep-dives.

Proposed compact slots (all times given in UTC, with local conversions):
- Option A: 2026-12-15 14:30–15:15 UTC (US PST: 06:30–07:15; UK GMT: 14:30–15:15; Japan JST: 23:30–00:15)
- Option B: 2026-12-16 08:00–08:45 UTC (US PST: 00:00–00:45; UK GMT: 08:00–08:45; India IST: 13:30–14:15)
- Option C: 2026-12-17 12:00–12:45 UTC (US PST: 04:00–04:45; UK GMT: 12:00–12:45; Japan JST: 21:00–21:45)

Notes:
- Option A is late for APAC (Japan join at end of day) but minimizes odd-hours for EMEA.
- Option B is very early for the US West coast but hits India mid-day which may be ideal if India stakeholders are required.
- Option C is a balance but still requires an early start for the US.

I've attached a CSV with a compact slot grid and flagged which regional leads have indicated potential availability (see attached proposed_slots_20261215.csv). If you confirm a preferred slot we will compress the demo to 30 minutes of live content + 15 minutes for Q&A and follow-up async notes.

Meeting link (provisional): https://redwood-demo-scheduler.example.com/session/KD-4821 (will lock when you confirm)

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_slots_20261215.csv (text/csv)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Satoshi Yamamoto <satoshi.y@kibohealth.co.jp>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@brighthealth.co.uk>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — team availability constraints

Team — quick sync from Redwood side:

We can run the demo as 30 minutes (core) + 15 minutes Q&A. Requesting two small changes:
1) Can we put Aditya on for the first 10 minutes to demonstrate the routing/fallback policy UI? He can be remote for Option A/C.
2) Please confirm whether India participants must be physically present (Diwali OOO is strict for some vendors) — if they're OOO we will record the demo and push a 20-minute highlights clip to them.

Connor — I approved a 15% time compression plan on the deck to fit the 30-minute core. If we go with Option A we should start the demo with a 5-minute welcome and go straight into the latency walkthrough.

Satoshi — attaching a quick regional holiday matrix I compiled to help visualize overlaps.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: regional_holiday_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@brighthealth.co.uk>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Satoshi Yamamoto <satoshi.y@kibohealth.co.jp>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:03:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Demo follow-up — team availability constraints

Connor / Lauren —

Option A (2026-12-15 14:30–15:15 UTC) works for UK and Japan leadership — Japan will join until ~23:45 JST, India is likely OOO for Diwali prep for part of that week so they asked us to record the demo. We can have a UK technical lead and my product lead on the call. Please keep the live demo strictly 30 minutes; we'll use the extra 15 minutes for a quick handoff and to note recorded follow-up items for India.

Confirming Option A. Please send the final calendar invite and lock the meeting link. Also, can you include the short recording plan so my APAC contacts have the expectation for asynchronous playback?

Thanks,
Priya Kapoor
Head of Partnerships, BrightHealth

On Tue, 15 Dec 2026 at 01:05, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai> wrote:

>
